lm.title: Tiny Shakespeare · causal transformer
lm.short_context: 312,448-parameter six-block character transformer; 8,192 fixed test targets. Cross-entropy is per character, not per LLM token.

digits.title: 8×8 digits · residual MLP
digits.short_context: 1,797 handwritten digit images, split into 1,078 train / 359 validation / 360 test rows; this is not MNIST or the original writer-disjoint UCI protocol.

spending.scope: Local CPU only. No paid experiment service; electricity and hardware amortization excluded.
